prior_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi now holds Sir Brandon's magical sword (beat_54) and laid out a plan for the hunt, but the dragon is still at large and the bounty unclaimed.
The plan to pay Lady Hilda with an advance from the reeve adds to the hiring, which is still pending.
The offer was accepted: Ned is now formally hired on new terms, paying 10 gold back per murder with the body his (beat_1), and has offered to buy the goblin bodies.
Getting the shirt through Dunk's scheme remains a step in the party's plan; the shirt is not yet obtained.
Squints proved himself by killing the ooze and is acting under Trout's orders; the recruitment terms and Trout's secret intent still stand.
Dunk's potion scheme is still part of the plan and the debt to Ingrid is unfulfilled.
The sword was found in Sir Brandon's sarcophagus and taken by Sir Phidipaldi (beat_54), and Brother Dirk came along to the Barrow, so nothing about the retrieval remains open.
The party reached the Barrow Mound but no penance or donation was shown, so the debt stands.

new_threads.name: The undead swordsman of the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: A huge, angry undead figure with a greatsword, possibly one of Brandon's companions, has slaughtered goblins below and has just appeared in the tomb's doorway (beat_55); the danger is live.

new_threads.name: The Free Goblin Society's bargain
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi promised to clear the evil from the mound and keep the goblins hidden from King Hogboon in exchange for their company and his 'father's goods' (beat_14); the clearing is unfinished.

new_threads.name: Brother Dirk and the Barrow's holy relics
new_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah wears the robes of Saint Arthur, whose magic is untested, over Dirk's offence, and whether the chalice belongs to the church was left to 'figure out later' (beat_49).

new_threads.name: The noblewoman statue and the voice in the tomb
new_threads.reason: No one knows who the noblewoman statue depicts or whose voice asked the knightly riddle; the doors opened but the question stands.

standalone_beats.reason: Real gemstones inlaid in the antechamber mosaics are a notable potential haul.
Dr. Uriah found a jewel-encrusted ceremonial dagger worth over 200 gold.
Discovery of the crypt's secret room that held the candleholders and the relics.
The party took seven gold candleholders worth 50 gold each.
The five urns, worth 100 gold each, were opened and found to hold only dust.

shared_subjects.subject: Sir Brandon's magical sword, now carried by Sir Phidipaldi
shared_subjects.reason: The retrieval is done and the sword is now a resource for killing the dragon.

shared_subjects.subject: The undead greatsword-wielder killing goblins below
shared_subjects.reason: The danger has its own thread, though clearing it is what the goblin bargain requires.

shared_subjects.subject: Ned's offer to buy the goblin bodies and the need to sneak them past the goblins
shared_subjects.reason: The sale is part of Ned's arrangement, and the goblins' objection blocks it.

shared_subjects.subject: An advance from the reeve to pay Lady Hilda
shared_subjects.reason: The advance is planned to fund the party's undertaking to hire Hilda.
